counterparts_needing_dossiers.name: Yan (An Lushan, Shi Siming, Shi Chaoyi)

problems: Page budget: 17 distinct pages were opened (Tang 15 of its own plus Gao Kaidao and Transition from Sui to Tang, shared with gao-kaidao) against a Tang budget of 14 and Gao Kaidao budget of 2; the extra Tang page is the emperor list, kept so the ruler strip rests on an opened page. sources_total counts per dossier (19), distinct pages 17.

The Phase A example was checked against re-opened pages; claims the pages do not carry were removed or rewritten (listed in the notes file): no 783 treaty name, no Tang-Uyghur alliance 788-789, no Goguryeo-Tang war start year, Khotan/Kashgar 632 submission, and others.

Sister dossiers (ea-03) exist for the Sui-Tang warlords, Gaochang, Kucha, Xueyantuo and Baekje; the Tang ledger uses their slugs. Their dates differ from the Transition page in places (Wu surrendered at Hangzhou winter 621 with Zhejiang as its land; Qin ended December 618; Chu 622): see the notes file.
Tang ledger events 0 and 1 (618 Qin gain, no month, before the 618-06 found event) are in validator order because a missing month sorts as 0.

The ledger keeps names (not slugs) for counterparts with no dossier yet: Yan (An Lushan), Qi (Huang Chao), Guiyi Circuit (Zhang Yichao), Liu Heita (Handong), Fu Gongshi (Song), Li Gui (Liang of Hexi), Karasahr, Tiele and Uyghur tribes (Yanran Protectorate), Sogdian and Tokharistan principalities.
